name: Connected Component Labeling for Voxel Filtering
definition: An algorithm to identify and retain only large connected components of occupied voxels, filtering out small noise or isolated artifacts. It operates on a 3D boolean voxel grid.
summary: Connected Component Labeling for Voxel Filtering retains only large, topologically coherent voxel clusters by enforcing spherical connectivity, distinguishing itself from uniform sampling methods by targeting noise removal in sparse 3D grids.
